highlights: Added /model-guide skill in wv-onboarding covering Anthropic Claude (Claude Sonnet & Claude Opus) and Google Gemini model selection in Antigravity Desktop, IDE, and CLI (/model, --model, --effort, /usage).

Added automatic Side-Pane Rendered Visual Artifacts (dashboard-standalone.html, deck.html, flyer.html in the Conversation Artifact Directory) + 1-click Browser Launch URL Cards (.url.json) + built-in wv-design-preview UI Sidecar on 127.0.0.1:4175 so business users see rendered dashboards/slides/flyers instead of raw HTML source code.
Initial release across all 6 State of West Virginia onboarding categories (20 slash-command skills + 113 public-sector playbook recipes).

Zero-install Gemini Enterprise (GE) Federated Connector Bridge running on Antigravity's built-in agy-node runtime (supports Entra-synced Google Identity + Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Gmail, Drive, and GitHub).
Zero-Node Browser Mode for /wv-dashboard, /slides, and /doc-design so locked-down state corporate laptops need zero extra local software.
Fast <2-second HTTPS ZIP and Git sparse-checkout installer/updater (/wv-update).
